nodes.label: index.js start()
nodes.desc: Entry point: builds dist if the commit hash changed, runs onboarding, then dynamically imports Controller from dist/controller.js and starts it.

nodes.label: checkDist() tsc build
nodes.desc: Compares the stored .hash with git rev-parse and runs pnpm run prepack when the source changed; caps old-space memory at 256 MB for small boards.

nodes.label: onboard()
nodes.desc: First-run wizard: if no MQTT server or serial port is configured, the process serves an onboarding page instead of starting.

nodes.label: Z2M_WATCHDOG restart
nodes.desc: On an unsolicited stop, the process is re-entered with escalating delays (2s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h) instead of exiting.

nodes.label: Controller
nodes.desc: Orchestrator: builds the four core services, registers built-in extensions, starts them sequentially, then republishes cached states so consumers wake up with current values.

nodes.label: EventBus
nodes.desc: Typed pub/sub hub: ~22 events including deviceMessage, mqttMessage, publishEntityState, lastSeenChanged. Callbacks are wrapped so an extension crash logs instead of throwing.

nodes.label: Extension base
nodes.desc: Abstract class every feature module extends; its stop() removes all of its event listeners, which is how Zigbee2MQTT shuts down cleanly.

nodes.label: publishEntityState()
nodes.desc: Single output choke point: merges payload with cached state, adds last_seen/linkquality, honors retain/qos/retention options, and emits as JSON and/or per-attribute topics.

nodes.label: Zigbee
nodes.desc: Configures and wraps the zigbee-herdsman Controller: network keys, database.db path, serial transport (port, baudrate, rtscts, adapter type).

nodes.label: zigbee-herdsman (dep)
nodes.desc: Pinned dependency (11.2.0) that owns the actual serial adapter communication, Zigbee network management and the device database.

nodes.label: zh Controller.start()
nodes.desc: Starts the radio stack, resolves device definitions for all joined devices, and enforces passlist/blocklist by kicking non-matching devices off the network.

nodes.label: herdsman.on('message')
nodes.desc: Every raw Zigbee frame (cluster, type, data, endpoint) is resolved to a Device and re-emitted on the EventBus as deviceMessage; frames from the coordinator itself are dropped.

nodes.label: Mqtt
nodes.desc: MQTT client: LWT on bridge/state, subscribes to <base_topic>/#, publishes with per-topic retain/qos and caches retained payloads locally.

nodes.label: Mqtt.onMessage()
nodes.desc: Filters out messages Zigbee2MQTT itself published (publishedTopics set) before forwarding incoming MQTT traffic to the EventBus.

nodes.label: Mqtt.publish()
nodes.desc: Prefixes the base topic, rejects wildcard characters, remembers retained payloads, and emits mqttMessagePublished for stats.

nodes.label: retainedMessages cache
nodes.desc: Republishes all retained messages 2s after each reconnect for brokers that do not persist them; cancelled by the next bridge/info.

nodes.label: Bridge
nodes.desc: Control plane: publishes bridge/info, bridge/devices, bridge/groups, bridge/logging and serves an RPC surface over bridge/request/*.

nodes.label: requestLookup RPC
nodes.desc: Command table: device/rename, device/remove, group/add, permit_join, touchlink/factory_reset, install_code/add, restart, backup and more, each returning a typed Zigbee2MQTTResponse.

nodes.label: bridge/logging transport
nodes.desc: A custom winston transport that mirrors every log line (except debug) onto the bridge/logging MQTT topic so external dashboards can tail logs.

nodes.label: Frontend
nodes.desc: Optional HTTP(S) server that serves the zigbee2mqtt-frontend package statically plus device icons, and upgrades to a WebSocket under base_url/api.

nodes.label: WebSocket /api
nodes.desc: Subscribes to publishEntityState and mqttMessagePublished events, mirroring MQTT traffic live to the browser UI.

nodes.label: Receive
nodes.desc: Inbound extension: matches frames to converters, applies elapsed option, debounce and throttle, and publishes the converted payload.

nodes.label: fromZigbee filter
nodes.desc: Selects device.definition.fromZigbee converters whose cluster and frame type match; genOta/genTime/genBasic/genPollCtrl frames are skipped instead of erroring.

nodes.label: debounce / throttle
nodes.desc: Per-device coalescing: chatty sensors can set debounce or throttle seconds in options; conflicting payloads flush immediately, and the cache is updated eagerly.

nodes.label: Publish
nodes.desc: Outbound extension: subscribes to mqttMessage, parses topics, matches attribute keys to toZigbee converters and drives Zigbee writes plus optimistic state.

nodes.label: parseTopic() get|set
nodes.desc: Regex over <base_topic>/<entity>[/endpoint]/get|set[/attribute]; bare 'on'/'off' payloads are accepted as {state: ...} without JSON.

nodes.label: toZigbee match
nodes.desc: For each payload key finds the first toZigbee converter with a matching key and endpoint, applies convertSet (or convertGet), and collects optimistic state per entity.

nodes.label: Availability
nodes.desc: Publishes availability online/offline per device based on last-seen timeouts or ping tests, in parallel to the state flow.

nodes.label: OTAUpdate
nodes.desc: Handles firmware updates: checks the device definition's ota provider, streams the image over Zigbee and reports progress on the update topic.

nodes.label: Device
nodes.desc: Wraps the zh.Device with a resolved converter definition, friendly name from settings, endpoints and exposes; isSupported distinguishes real converters from generated placeholders.

nodes.label: resolveDefinition()
nodes.desc: Calls zhc.findByDevice() after interview, caching by modelID; this is the moment a physical device gets its fromZigbee/toZigbee/exposes mapping.

nodes.label: exposes() catalog
nodes.desc: Returns the definition's capability list (switch, light, sensor exposes) and appends a synthetic linkquality expose to every device.

nodes.label: State (state.json)
nodes.desc: In-memory Map keyed by entity ID with a 5-minute save interval; on stop it drops states of devices no longer on the network.

nodes.label: data dir (ZIGBEE2MQTT_DATA)
nodes.desc: Single place that resolves the data directory (env override, default ../data relative to dist) where database.db, state.json and coordinator backups live.
